items.name: Cloak of the Taken Isle
items.lore: Red, with the lake's whirlpool on it. Sewn on the island for those who were there the day it was taken.

items.name: Lakewarden's Bracer
items.lore: The Guard's watch on the island wears these. The leather never quite dries.

items.name: Shore-Fort Torc
items.lore: Bronze from the Dergans' own forge on the island, beaten into something better.

items.name: Sealskin Mantle
items.lore: Not a roane's own skin - they would never. Grey seal from the far coast, traded for the island's freedom.

items.name: Roane Pearl Necklace
items.lore: Lake pearls, which the roane say only grow where someone has sung over the water.

items.name: Selkie-Song Ring
items.lore: Hold it to your ear at night and you can hear them singing out on the lake.

items.name: Tide-Woven Belt
items.lore: Woven from lake reeds by roane hands, and stronger than it has any right to be.

items.name: Ruadhan's Red Hand
items.lore: The warlord's own ring: a red hand closed round a lake stone. It's lighter now.
